title: Shooting Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🎥️shooting plugin (single app, single artifact — icon-studio) from its 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎥️shooting/📦️packages/🦀️rust/ (crate name semio-s-plugin-shooting) with the full taxonomy source tree, following the W2 fan-out recipe in .🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md (written from the 🌊️flow pilot). Exclusive ownership: everything under ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎥️shooting/**. Old crates: 🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact (semio-s-plugin-shooting bundle), 🎛️apps/🎥️shooting (semio-s-app-shooting), and its 🔨️modules/{⚙️engine,🎒️pack,📡️protocol,🔧️op,🗣️dsl,🖱️ui} (semio-s-app-shooting-{engine,pack,protocol,op,dsl,ui}). NOTE: found the old ui crate's 📦️lib.rs handle() method already mid-refactored to the Result<Emit,Fault> trait shape with systematic broken syntax (missing closing parens on ~25 Ok(Emit::operations(...)) call sites, some Emit{...} literals not Ok-wrapped, missing Fault import) — forward-fixing this as part of the migration baseline per CLAUDE.md (fix bugs at the root, no reverts).
summary:
Migrated the 🎥️shooting plugin (single app "shooting", single artifact "shooting" — icon studio) from its 7-crate constitutional layout into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🎥️shooting/📦️packages/🦀️rust (semio-s-plugin-shooting), following TEMPLATE.md's W2 fan-out recipe.

PRE-EXISTING BUG FOUND AND FIXED (forward-fix, not a revert): the old 🖱️ui crate's 📦️lib.rs `handle()` method was already mid-refactored toward the `Result<Emit<_,_>, Fault>` trait shape (matching flow's already-migrated pattern) but had ~25 systematically broken call sites — every `Ok(Emit::operations(vec![...])` was missing its closing `)` (a mechanical find/replace that added `Ok(` prefixes without matching parens), a couple of `Emit{...}` struct literals were not `Ok()`-wrapped at all, and `Fault` was never imported. This blocked ALL compilation of the old crate. Fixed via ~10 targeted Edits (all parens balanced, `Fault` added to the semio_framework_plugin import list) to establish a clean baseline before migrating.

BASELINE (old 7 crates, after the fix): cargo test passed 2+0+9+4+5+11+4+24 = 59 tests total across semio-s-plugin-shooting/semio-s-app-shooting/-engine/-pack/-protocol/-op/-dsl/-ui. Wire baseline: a temp [DEBUG] test dumped print_op/encode_op hex for 49 representative ShootingCommand values (42 variants, some with both Some/None branches) into the ticket folder.

NEW CRATE: full taxonomy tree — 🗿️artifacts/🎥️shooting/{🦀️component.rs, 🔺️diff, 🔧️op, 🗣️dsl, 🎒️pack, 📡️spr, ⚙️engine}, 🎛️apps/🎥️shooting/{🦀️component.rs, 🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🦀️wasm.rs, 🎮️commands/9 groups (fixture/shot/asset/camera/scene/gumball/selection/locale/export) covering all 42 ShootingCommand rows via `app_commands!`, 🎭️modes/✏️edit/{🦀️component.rs, 🪟️windows/{🎥️scene,🖼️icon} each with its own 🎚️options/* (8+3=11 measure files)}, 📌️panels/{📄️document,🛍️catalogue,🔍️inspection}}. Plugin-root 📦️lib.rs is wiring-only per TaxonomyLibShape.

Framework gap NOT already covered by W0/W1: none — flow's `app_commands!` (keyed form, no ctx needed since ShootingPlayApp is a pure unit struct) covered everything except ONE case: `ExportShots{all:bool}` has a PAYLOAD-DEPENDENT manifest action id (exportActiveShot vs exportAllShots) which app_commands!'s generated `command_id()` (static 1:1 row→literal) cannot express. Fixed by overriding `DocumentApp::command_id` at the app level with a manual match arm for ExportShots that falls back to `other.command_id()` for everything else — no framework macro change needed, no wire-format impact. Documented inline.

VERIFICATION (all against the new crate via a temporary `[workspace]` overlay in its Cargo.toml, removed at handoff per TEMPLATE.md §3):
1. cargo check --manifest-path (native): clean, 0 warnings for semio-s-plugin-shooting.
2. cargo check --manifest-path --target wasm32-wasip2: clean, 0 warnings, "Finished in 14m 34s" (concurrent-agent CPU contention, not a crate issue).
3. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean (0 errors) after fixing: 3× PluginApp trait import (handle_action/render need it in scope in gumball/scene-window/icon-window test modules), 8× map(f).unwrap_or(_)/unwrap_or_else(_) → map_or/map_or_else, 1× needless borrow, 1× default-constructed unit struct (ShootingPlayApp::default() → ShootingPlayApp), 1× large_enum_variant on ShootingConfigOperation (allowed with reason — same pre-migration shape, not a size regression), 3× approx_constant on the 0.7071 quaternion test fixture literal (allowed with reason — deliberately approximate test data), 3× redundant_clone in op test helpers, 1× field_reassign_with_default in a DWG-import test.
4. cargo test --manifest-path: 97 passed, 0 failed (superset of the 59-test baseline — same coverage plus new per-node/command-surface tests the taxonomy split calls for).
4b. Wire-format diff: byte-identical across all 49 baseline rows (🧪️wire-baseline-before.txt vs 🧪️wire-baseline-after.txt in this ticket folder, diff is empty) — proves the app_commands! decomposition did not alter print_op text or encode_op bytes for any ShootingCommand variant.
4c. Manual taxonomy audit: every artifact node has diff/dsl/pack/op/spr/engine; every window's options dir contains only leaf component.rs files; plugin lib.rs is wiring-only (#[path] mod declarations + semio_plugin!{} call, no logic); ran the registry's read-only `check` command — reported only the expected generic "catalog is stale" (registrar's job), no shooting-specific error.
5. Old crates deleted only after 1-4 passed: rm -rf 🛂️manifest/, 🎛️apps/🎥️shooting/⚡️implementations/, 🎛️apps/🎥️shooting/🔨️modules/ (engine/pack/protocol/op/dsl/ui).
6. Cross-cutting dependent found and fixed: 🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🗣️dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/{Cargo.toml,📦️lib.rs} — repointed its `shooting` dev-dependency from the deleted `semio-s-app-shooting` facade to the new `semio-s-plugin-shooting` crate, and its `use shooting::ShootingFixture` to `use shooting::artifacts::shooting::ShootingFixture` (same pattern already used for writer/vcs/animate/cad by prior W2 agents). Did NOT attempt to build the whole fixture-sweep crate (it depends on every plugin, several of which are mid-migration by concurrent sibling agents right now).
7. 🎪️demonstrator: grepped its Cargo.toml files — no reference to any shooting crate name found, nothing to flag.
8. Registry generate/root Cargo.toml edit: NOT done (registrar's job, per protocol).
